docs.summary: How a rigidbody's Transform is filled in between physics steps. Physics runs at a fixed rate, so without smoothing the visuals move in fixed-rate jumps whenever the frame rate differs from it.
Write the simulated pose as-is. Cheapest, and visibly steps at high frame rates.
Render between the last two steps. Smooth, at the cost of trailing one fixed step behind.
Predict ahead of the last step from the body's velocity. No lag, but can overshoot a collision.
